name: configure_display_surface
description: Looks up two handles through a lookup routine, releasing them via library stubs when a lookup fails, then sets a flag byte in the associated display structure and calls a routine with the sizes 640 and 256. It finishes by passing the stored handles to further calls, using graphics.library and intuition.library.

name: clear_block_and_store_pointers
description: Zeroes forty-one 32-bit words starting at an offset from a base pointer taken from the stack, then stores the address of a small stack buffer and a global value into two fields of that same block. It then calls one further routine.

name: call_optional_handler
description: Calls the function pointer held in a global variable when that variable is non-zero, then calls one further routine and returns.

name: split_string_into_word_array
description: Scans a text buffer using a character class table, replaces the separators with null bytes and builds a null-terminated array of pointers to the words it finds. It also looks up two identifiers from a table and sets up related script and object pointers, with dos.library and mathffp.library calls in the referenced text.

name: initialize_state_then_return
description: Calls another routine ten times, then calls an optional handler from a global and conditionally calls routines with values taken from globals. When one global flag is clear it returns the result of a final call on the input value, otherwise it returns the input unchanged.

name: append_string_to_end
description: Walks to the end of the destination string and appends bytes from the source string, stopping at the source terminator or after roughly 32 thousand bytes, then null-terminates the result.

name: append_string_with_count
description: Walks to the end of the destination string and appends bytes from the source, stopping at the source terminator or when the count argument runs out, then null-terminates the destination and returns it.

name: copy_cstring_to_buffer
description: Copies bytes from the source string into the destination buffer up to and including the zero terminator, then returns the destination pointer.

name: measure_string_length
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string to its terminator and returns the number of bytes before it. It does not modify memory.

name: copy_bytes_zero_padded
description: Copies up to a counted number of bytes from the source, stopping early after a zero byte, then fills the rest of the destination up to that count with zeros. It returns the destination pointer.

name: release_indexed_slot
description: Checks that an index from zero to nineteen refers to a non-empty six-byte slot in a table. For an invalid index it stores an error code in a global and returns minus one; for a valid one it releases the stored handle unless the slot's high flag is set, clears the slot and returns zero.

name: forward_to_library_function
description: Loads a library base pointer from a global variable and jumps indirectly through a vector in that library, passing control to the library function without further work.

name: forward_to_library_routine
description: Loads the same library base pointer from a global variable and jumps indirectly through a different vector in that library, handing control straight to its function.

name: forward_to_library_entry
description: Loads a library base pointer from a global variable and jumps through its vector at a fixed offset, returning to the caller through that function.

name: start_from_cli_or_workbench
description: Clears a global block of nearly four thousand longwords, then reads the process message to decide whether the program was started from the Workbench or the command line. It copies the command line arguments or fetches the Workbench directory and file name, then runs the main routines and cleanup calls, using dos.library and exec.library functions.

name: close_libraries_on_exit
description: Runs an optional cleanup handler from a global, then calls exec-library functions that close the libraries and exit the interrupt, and when a pair of globals is set it closes the library bases as well.

name: try_library_call_then_cleanup
description: Calls a library function and stores its result in a global; if that result is non-zero it returns it. Otherwise it runs the optional cleanup handler and the same library-closing sequence, then returns 100.

name: stub_return_void
description: Returns immediately without any work, so it is an empty stub.

name: stub_no_operation
description: Returns to the caller immediately without doing any work, so it is an empty routine.

name: release_linked_list_nodes
description: Walks a singly linked list from a global head pointer, calling an exec-library function on each node, then clears the head and the count fields and returns zero.

name: tokenize_arguments_and_configure
description: Splits a command-line string into up to thirty-two tokens, keeping double-quoted words together and storing the token count. Depending on whether any tokens were found it either copies default text or reads library values, then sets flag bits and a handler pointer and passes the tokens to a further routine.

name: setup_graphics_viewport_and_text
description: Opens a graphics library and builds a viewport with a copper list, loads a four-bit colour table, sets the drawing pen and drawing mode, and draws text at fixed positions in a raster port, all through graphics.library jump stubs.

name: allocate_and_initialize_game_tables
description: Allocates several memory blocks through the library memory functions after checking available memory, then fills sized tables of entries and clears flag and state fields to initial values. It finishes by calling routines that set up the display from the loaded values.

name: redraw_entries_and_restore_state
description: Saves a 32-bit state value, redraws several table entries from slices of object data, and clears or fills entries depending on a flag argument. It then restores the saved value and returns the chosen result, touching the DMA control hardware register.

name: run_state_machine_frames
description: Advances a frame counter, clears a table of 120 two-word records, then loops dispatching on a state byte to one of several state routines until the requested number of frames has elapsed. It ends by toggling a flag byte.

name: initialize_slot_positions
description: Assigns a position and a handler pointer to each of seventeen slots, skipping one slot per group. It then loops, calling update routines and recounting active slots, until the count reaches the total derived from two side values.

name: animate_slots_for_frames
description: Initialises seventeen slot records with positions and handler pointers, then steps horizontal and vertical counters within limits for up to 400 iterations. It updates the active slots on each pass and calls a routine at specific iterations.

name: toggle_side_and_populate_slots
description: Toggles a side flag byte from a comparison with a stored value, adjusts a counter for that side, and fills the slot records with positions chosen by the side. It then loops adjusting two counters and a timer until a limit is reached, and sets a state flag at the end.

name: invert_side_and_populate_slots
description: Increments a counter for the inverted side flag, fills the slot records with positions chosen by that side, then loops adjusting two counters until a limit is reached. It ends by setting a state flag.

name: populate_slots_and_animate
description: Fills the slot records with positions and handler pointers across seventeen entries, then loops adjusting two counters and updating active slots until a limit is reached. It ends by resetting a state byte and setting a flag.

name: fill_slot_rows_and_animate
description: Fills the slot records for each row with positions and handler pointers, then steps two counters within limits over up to 400 iterations while counting active slots. It ends by setting a state flag.

name: step_counters_until_limit
description: Sets two fixed fields to twelve, then steps two counters within limits over up to 400 iterations while counting active slots. It finishes by resetting a state byte and setting a flag.

name: reset_state_and_call_routine
description: Clears a state byte, calls a routine with the constants one, twenty, eight thousand and sixty-four along with a stored value, then sets a flag byte.

name: step_counters_toward_targets
description: Derives two target values from position fields, clamps them to the ranges zero to 607 and zero to 83, and moves two stored counters one step toward each target.

name: update_animation_frame_and_positions
description: Calls two routines with fixed values, then refreshes the display entries for eighteen and four slots, eases one counter halfway toward a derived target and clamps a second counter to a range. It advances a frame counter that wraps after 120 steps and calls two routines when a text character matches one of two values.

name: refresh_entries_and_frame_counter
description: Clears a flag byte, refreshes the display entries for eighteen and four slots, and eases one counter halfway toward a derived target. It clamps a second counter and advances a frame counter that wraps after 120 steps, calling two routines when a text character matches.

name: update_four_entries_and_frame
description: Refreshes four display entries, eases one counter halfway toward a derived target, clamps a second counter and advances a frame counter that wraps after 120 steps. It calls two routines when a text character matches one of two values.

name: update_positions_and_frame_only
description: Eases one counter halfway toward a derived target, clamps a second counter to a range, and advances a frame counter that wraps after 120 steps. It calls two routines when a text character matches one of two values.

name: reset_entries_and_update_frame
description: Clears a state byte, calls routines that set up eighteen entries and four entries from a table, then advances a wrapping frame counter. It calls two routines when a text character matches one of two values.

name: wait_until_status_flag_set
description: Sets up a handler pointer and a field, then loops calling a routine until one of two status bytes becomes non-zero. It then calls a routine with the values 7000 and 10 and sets a byte to 240.

name: refresh_active_slot_display
description: For an active slot, refreshes eighteen and four display entries, eases one counter halfway toward a target derived from a stored value, and clamps a second counter to a range. It then calls another routine with the results.

name: run_direction_input_loop
description: Initialises fields according to a mode value, then loops reading a direction bitmask and mapping it to a step between minus two and plus two. It moves a wrapping position counter until a stop flag is set, calls a routine with 25 for certain bit patterns, and finally refreshes eighteen display entries.

name: draw_two_text_labels
description: Sets the drawing pen and draw mode on a raster port, then draws a byte string at two fixed positions, moving the pen before each call. It restores the stored port pointer afterwards, using graphics.library jump stubs.

name: draw_offset_text_pair
description: Draws a text string twice, once at the given coordinates with one pen value and once offset by two units with a second pen value. Each draw is preceded by a move of the pen, using graphics.library jump stubs.

name: draw_and_count_down_handler
description: Calls a routine to compute a value, draws at a horizontal position derived from four times that value and a fixed vertical position, then decrements a countdown. It clears the handler pointer when the countdown reaches zero.

name: init_sequence_state_fields
description: Stores constants into a state block: a long value of 606464, a zero word, a long value of 4032, the words 20 and 650, and a handler pointer. These set the initial state for a sequence.

name: init_secondary_sequence_fields
description: Stores constants into a second state block: a long value of 288000, a zero word, a long value of 4032, the words 40 and 200, and a handler pointer. These set the initial state for an alternate sequence.

name: advance_scroll_state_machine
description: Advances a four-phase state machine: the first and third phases store two values from routines, while the second and fourth phases count down a counter and move two position fields by stored deltas through scroll routines. An unknown phase clears the handler pointer.

name: start_scroll_phase_with_deltas
description: Stores two values obtained from routines as scroll deltas and sets the phase to one.

name: restart_scroll_phase_deltas
description: Stores two values obtained from routines as scroll deltas and sets the phase to one, repeating the start of the scroll phase sequence.

name: clear_status_long_field
description: Stores zero into a long-word field two bytes past a base pointer and returns.

name: initialize_entry_table_and_palette
description: Initialises twelve table entries, giving each a position, flags and a palette index taken from lookup tables, then sets starting position and scroll values. It finishes by loading sixteen colour values through a graphics.library call.

name: find_and_remove_named_task
description: Looks up a task by a name at a fixed offset and, when one is found, removes it through the exec library. It returns zero when no task is found, otherwise the result of the removal call.

name: load_view_and_wait_frame
description: Waits for the vertical blank, loads a view from a stored pointer, and waits for the vertical blank again, using graphics.library calls.

name: draw_and_clear_entry_list
description: Loops over a count byte of entries, calls a routine with an offset derived from a width field and a second field for each, then zeroes the two words of each entry.

name: start_audio_channel_dma
description: Stores a sample pointer and length for an audio channel, writes the channel period register and sets the volume. It then writes the DMA control register with that channel's bit and the enable bit set, so the channel starts playing.

name: run_side_counter_sequence
description: Loops five times, adding one to a side counter whenever a routine returns one and calling routines with 50 on each pass. It repeats the same test until the two side counters differ, then calls routines with 250 and clears the handler pointer.

name: unlink_node_from_list
description: If the node's flag bit is clear, unlinks it from a doubly linked list by updating its neighbours' pointers. It then sets the flag bit to mark the node as removed.

name: set_node_byte_fields
description: Stores each of two arguments into byte fields of a referenced structure when they are non-negative, and returns the last value stored.

name: run_count_loop_or_fail
description: Obtains a count from a routine; if the count is at least one it clears a field, calls a routine once per index up to the count, then calls two more routines and returns zero. Otherwise it returns one.

name: set_table_flag_entry
description: Sets the long-word entry at an index of a flag table to one.

name: free_bucketed_node_lists
description: Walks seventy-one buckets of linked nodes and, when the flag argument is non-zero, releases each node's attached buffers and the node itself, then clears the bucket head. It finishes by calling one further routine with the parameters.

name: copy_bucket_heads_to_structure
description: Copies seventy-one bucket heads and a pointer field from one structure to another, sets a flag byte and a flag bit in the destination, and then calls a routine with the destination.

name: create_record_with_handler
description: Allocates a record through a routine, sets its type byte, a second byte, a pointer to a global area and a zero field, then stores a handler pointer. It passes the record to a further routine with the value five.

name: run_round_countdown_loop
description: Sets per-side state from a side index, resets several fields, loads a colour table and places entries with fixed values, then runs a countdown from eleven that adjusts animation frames and calls routines with the side value. The source listing is truncated, so the end of the routine is not recovered.

name: allocate_block_array
description: Calls a routine with the four parameters, then requests up to a count of blocks through a routine and stores each returned pointer in an array. It returns zero when every request succeeds, or minus one when one request fails.

name: relink_node_into_list
description: When the node's flag bit is set, takes a record from the head of a free list, clears the flag, links it onto the front of the target list and calls a routine with the node.

name: store_base_pointer_global
description: Stores the data base pointer into a global variable and returns.

name: init_record_from_table_entry
description: Initialises a record from a table entry, copying a pointer, a width and a height, and zeroes its counters and link fields. It sets a flag byte when the second argument is non-zero.

name: copy_string_and_return_length
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from source to destination including the terminator, counting the characters copied, and returns that count.

name: format_two_digit_text
description: Writes two characters into a buffer: the first is a tens digit obtained from a routine and shown as a blank when zero, the second is a digit made from the difference between the parameter and a second routine result.

name: convert_number_to_text_buffer
description: Converts a value into a fixed text buffer through a routine, clears a flag byte, and passes the buffer to another routine with a length of two.

name: build_status_text_line
description: Fills a fifty-character buffer with spaces, writes two text strings taken from table entries and two status digits into it, and returns the buffer address.

name: setup_entry_from_parameter
description: Copies four 16-bit values from a lookup table into a record, marks a slot as unused and sets its state from a table index. It then records a parameter value and clears two status bytes.

name: run_main_game_loop
description: Sets up the playfield with fixed sizes and loads graphics through library calls, then waits for the beam position. It loops forever, dispatching on a state value and redrawing the screen each frame.

name: repeat_call_count_times
description: Calls a routine once for each unit of the count argument, returning when the count is no longer positive.

name: fade_palette_entries_step
description: Steps each entry of a 32-colour palette down by one in each of its three nibble components, loads the result through a library call and calls a routine with the parameter. This repeats for sixteen passes.

name: fade_palette_toward_target
description: Clears a 32-entry palette, then for sixteen passes moves each colour's three nibble components one step toward a target palette. After each pass it loads the palette and calls a routine with the parameter.

name: blit_slot_bitmap
description: Looks up a bitmap record in a slot table and, when one is present, blits it into the raster port at the given coordinates using a graphics.library call. It returns the blit result, or zero when the slot is empty.

name: toggle_display_buffer_and_draw
description: Toggles a double-buffer flag, switches the view and raster port pointers to the other buffer, and copies 32 colour words from a default table. It then draws each entry in a list through another routine.

name: find_region_code_at_point
description: Searches a list of eight-byte rectangle records for one that contains the given point and returns its code byte. It returns zero when the list ends without a match.

name: run_cursor_movement_loop
description: Redraws a cursor image at its current position and loops until a stop flag is set. Each pass reads direction bits, moves the position by three or four units within fixed bounds, waits for the vertical beam position and redraws when the position has changed.

name: fill_rectangle_for_matching_record
description: Scans a list of eight-byte records terminated by zero for one whose key matches the argument. When one is found it sets the draw mode and fills the rectangle described by its coordinates and sizes, using graphics.library calls.

name: poll_key_to_character
description: Performs a handshake on a hardware byte by writing a fixed value and waiting for the serial status bit, then matches the received code against a table of code pairs. It repeats until the matched character is non-zero and returns it.

name: poll_key_code_until_mapped
description: Repeats a hardware handshake and reads a received code, scanning a table of code pairs for the code and returning the mapped character once one is found.

name: draw_text_with_fill_padding
description: Moves to a position, draws a text string, then draws a fixed fill character repeatedly until the field reaches the given count, using graphics.library text and move calls.

name: draw_indexed_status_entry
description: Looks up a status index in a table of fourteen-byte entries. When the value is at least 32 or the flag is zero it stores three fields and draws the entry, otherwise it loads a palette and draws a separate entry.

name: draw_scrolling_table_rows
description: Draws a box and twenty table rows from a scroll offset, choosing the pen and text for each row from flags and table values. It then draws a highlighted entry and loads a palette, using graphics.library calls.

name: draw_label_for_state
description: Draws a label chosen by a state value: when the value matches one code it copies four words from a table and draws the entry, otherwise it clears three words and draws the default label.

name: wait_for_selection_then_draw
description: Loops until a selection routine returns a non-zero code, mapping codes one, two and three to state values twenty-four, eight and two. It then redraws each item up to the stored state count.

name: handle_menu_input_loop
description: Loops until a selection flag is set, reading an input code and dispatching it. Codes two and three adjust a state byte and redraw, codes four to six set values from globals, codes eight and nine move a wrapping selection index, and code eleven resets a state byte, with each branch redrawing through routine calls.

name: dispatch_by_table_code
description: Searches a table of six-byte entries for the current code byte and jumps to the function pointer stored beside the matching entry. If no entry matches it calls a routine with fixed arguments.

name: draw_grid_of_table_cells
description: Draws eight rows of cells, positioning each cell from a table and repeating within a row while the table count entry is greater than one. It uses graphics.library drawing calls for the pen, mode and text.

name: run_selection_input_loop
description: Loops reading an input code and dispatching it: codes four and five set state bytes for the current item, codes six to eight set a zero state and a character value, and codes eleven and twelve move the item index within bounds. Code nine advances a counter that wraps at six, and code thirteen looks up a table to call a matching handler and returns.

name: draw_panel_then_wait
description: Draws a fixed panel of text fields with a value from a parameter table, then loops calling an input routine until one of two input status bytes becomes non-zero.

name: draw_single_value_and_wait
description: Draws a short label, a value taken from a table and a status line, then loops until one of two input status bytes becomes non-zero.

name: draw_six_row_table_panel
description: Draws a panel showing a letter from the parameter, a count, and six rows whose values come from table lookups, plus a summary line for the current index.

name: draw_ranked_entry_panel
description: Draws up to four ranked rows chosen from a sorted index table, each with a label and a value taken from a table, plus a short encoded text line for the current item.

name: sort_four_indexed_entries
description: Initialises four indices and sorts them by comparing two table fields, swapping entries when the first field is smaller or when the first fields tie and the second is smaller. It then packs a combined byte value for each entry.

name: draw_title_then_wait
description: Draws a title with a letter from the parameter, four table rows and their values, then loops until one of two input status bytes is set.

name: wait_for_unpaired_status_flag
description: Loops calling a routine until one of two status bytes is set without its partner byte being set, then returns.

name: stub_immediate_return_loop
description: Sets a flag to true and returns straight away, so the polling loop that follows never runs and the routine does no work.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Returns immediately without doing any work, so it is an empty stub.

name: initialize_ranking_table
description: Marks each entry as free, then fills six records by calling a routine for each and copying its values into four slots, replacing the lowest slot when a better value is found. It finishes by storing the chosen values into fixed fields.

name: run_selection_menu
description: Shows a selection list of up to fourteen entries and loops reading input. Code two returns one, codes four and five move the selection through matching entries, code three toggles an index in one mode, and the routine returns zero when the loop ends.

name: run_round_fixtures
description: Loops through rounds while the round counter is below fifteen. For each fixture it resets the pair state, then either computes outcome values from a routine and updates running totals, or runs the match display with graphics and sound calls, recording the outcome in the table.

name: set_result_flag_from_counts
description: Sets up a display with library calls, sets a state flag and clears a handler pointer, then sets a result word to zero or one depending on whether the first counter is below the second.

name: initialize_four_slot_codes
description: Calls routines to set up a display, then fills four slot entries with codes derived from their index and stores the first code as a result.

name: run_pair_table_fixtures
description: Fills a six-by-six table of pair codes and clears score fields, then runs thirty-six fixtures in turn, each waiting for input, taking an outcome from a routine, updating the two sides and drawing the result with graphics calls. The source listing is truncated, so the end of the routine is not recovered.

name: open_display_window_and_show
description: Opens a display resource with two fixed arguments and, when it succeeds, prepares a raster port and draws its contents. It then runs a sequence of eleven display update calls and closes the resource when it was opened.

name: clear_four_buffers_with_blitter
description: Claims the blitter, clears four buffers each of a size equal to width times height halved, using the record's width and height, then releases the blitter. It uses the blitter ownership calls of the graphics library.

name: divide_32bit_software
description: Performs a software 32-bit division with sign handling, using shifts to normalise the divisor. It has a separate path for divisors that fit in sixteen bits and returns the result in the same register form.

name: get_string_byte_count
description: Walks a zero-terminated string to its terminator and returns the number of bytes before it.

name: process_nonempty_list_head
description: Returns the pointer unchanged when it is null or its first long is zero. Otherwise it passes the pointer plus four to a routine and returns that routine's result.

name: load_chunked_picture_file
description: Opens a file through a routine and reads chunks by their four-letter identifiers, handling a colour map chunk, a bitmap header chunk and a run-length data chunk while skipping unknown ones. It returns zero on success or one when the file cannot be opened.

name: sample_input_state_bits
description: Copies the four previous input state bytes into history, then sets the current input bytes from a global value by inverting and masking its bits. Bytes with values above ten, or equal to three or seven, are cleared.

name: allocate_double_buffer_resources
description: Allocates a control structure and a second block, then creates one or two sets of resources, each with small buffers and a sub-structure whose links are initialised. It returns minus one when any allocation or setup fails, otherwise zero.

name: read_frame_records_from_file
description: Reads a sequence of frame records from a file, allocating a block for each frame and storing its fields, and checks for an end-marker identifier before continuing. It returns one when the file cannot be read and zero when the records run out.

name: set_pointer_if_nonzero
description: When the first long at the argument is non-zero, stores the address one long past it into a global pointer, calls a routine and sets a flag.

name: free_double_buffer_resources
description: Releases the resources created for one or two buffers: for each set it frees the records and buffers in turn, then frees the control structure and the final pair of blocks.

name: allocate_tagged_record
description: Calls a routine to obtain a file handle and, when it is positive, allocates a block of the requested size plus four bytes, reads that many bytes from the file into it and stores the size in its first long. It returns the block, or null when a step fails.

name: multiply_32bit_software
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values in software by combining their 16-bit halves, returning the low 32 bits of the product.

name: dispatch_state_handlers_per_entry
description: Loops over a count of records, each 406 bytes long. For each one it saves the previous state, calls the handler stored in a table for the old state when the state has changed, and then calls the handler for the new state.

name: update_cached_frame_index
description: Copies a frame index into a cached field when it has changed or a force flag is set, then calls a routine with the new index and a fixed table.

name: redraw_slot_status_when_forced
description: When the force argument is non-zero, calls a routine with a fixed table entry and the status byte stored in the record.

name: redraw_slot_position_when_forced
description: When the force argument is non-zero, calls a routine with a second fixed table entry and the position byte stored in the record.

name: update_direction_from_offsets
description: Computes a direction code from the horizontal and vertical offsets to a target, stores it, and sets the state to eleven when the code is zero. Otherwise it calls a routine with a fixed table entry when the code has changed or a force flag is set.

name: update_state_byte_on_change
description: Stores the incoming byte into a status field when it differs from the stored value or a force flag is set, then calls a routine.

name: handle_state_change_with_offset
description: When the force argument is clear, sets the state to eleven if a flag bit is set. Otherwise it adjusts the vertical offset for two sprite types and calls a routine with a table entry chosen from two fields.

name: set_state_eleven_when_flagged
description: Sets the state word to eleven when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: set_state_eleven_or_redraw
description: When the force argument is non-zero, calls a routine with a fixed table entry and the status byte stored in the record. Otherwise it sets the state word to eleven when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: set_state_eleven_on_flag
description: Sets the state word to eleven when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: redraw_slot_second_entry
description: When the force argument is non-zero, calls a routine with a second fixed table entry and the stored status byte. Otherwise it sets the state word to eleven when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: set_state_eleven_if_flag
description: Sets the state word to eleven when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: redraw_slot_third_entry
description: Calls a routine with a fixed third table entry and the status byte stored in the record.

name: update_direction_clear_on_zero
description: Computes a direction code from the horizontal and vertical offsets to a target and stores it. It clears the state word when the code is zero, and otherwise calls a routine with a fixed table entry when the code has changed or a force flag is set.

name: store_status_redraw_on_change
description: Stores the incoming byte in the status field when it differs from the stored value or a force flag is set, then calls a routine.

name: clear_state_or_redraw_first
description: When the force argument is non-zero, calls a routine with a fixed table entry and the status byte stored in the record. Otherwise it clears the state word when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: clear_state_when_flagged
description: Clears the state word when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: clear_state_or_redraw_second
description: When the force argument is non-zero, calls a routine with a second fixed table entry and the status byte stored in the record. Otherwise it clears the state word when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: reset_state_on_flag_bit
description: Sets the state word to zero when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: reset_state_or_redraw_third
description: When the force argument is non-zero, calls a routine with a third fixed table entry and the status byte stored in the record. Otherwise it sets the state word to zero when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: reset_state_if_flag_set
description: Sets the state word to zero when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: reset_state_or_redraw_fourth
description: When the force argument is non-zero, calls a routine with a fourth fixed table entry and the status byte stored in the record. Otherwise it sets the state word to zero when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: reset_state_when_bit_set
description: Sets the state word to zero when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: clear_timers_or_redraw_entry
description: When the force argument is non-zero, calls a routine with a fixed table entry and the status byte stored in the record. Otherwise, when bit zero of a flag byte is set, it clears two long-word counters at offsets 20 and 24.

name: clear_timer_fields_when_flagged
description: Clears two long-word counters at offsets 20 and 24 when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: reset_state_or_redraw_fifth
description: When the force argument is non-zero, calls a routine with a fifth fixed table entry and the status byte stored in the record. Otherwise it sets the state word to zero when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: reset_state_if_bit_zero
description: Sets the state word to zero when bit zero of a flag byte is set.

name: classify_point_outside_bounds
description: Returns a bit mask describing whether the two arguments lie beyond fixed limits of plus or minus 576: bit value one when the first exceeds 576, two when it is below minus 576, four when the second is below minus 576, and eight when it exceeds 576.

name: classify_bounds_into_mask
description: Builds a bit mask from two arguments against limits of plus or minus 576: bit two when the first is below minus 576, bit eight when the second exceeds 576, and bit four when the second is below minus 576.

name: set_bit_below_lower_limit
description: Sets bit four in the mask when the second argument is below minus 576, and returns the mask.

name: decode_mask_to_direction
description: Decodes a bit mask into two direction values: bits one and two give a horizontal step of plus or minus one, and bits eight and four give a vertical step of plus or minus one. Each value is zero when its bits are clear.

name: load_entry_record_fields
description: Looks up an entry record from a table at an index, copies its byte fields into two status bytes and a mode byte, and sets a long field from the record. It also loads two position fields from table values divided by four, unless the matching byte is the letter c.

name: advance_entry_position_with_velocity
description: Adds velocity values to the position fields, updates the vertical position with an overflow check, and calls a routine to test the result. It then sets the record's derived fields from the new position.

name: nudge_entry_from_reference_point
description: Advances an entry by its velocity, then checks its distances to a fixed reference point and nudges its horizontal and vertical positions by 128 or 256 units when the offsets fall within set limits. It updates the status byte and derived fields after the nudge.

name: nudge_entry_when_near_reference
description: Checks an entry's distances to a fixed reference point and nudges its horizontal and vertical positions by 128 or 256 units when they fall within set limits. It then updates the status byte and derived fields.

name: nudge_entry_horizontal_offset
description: Nudges the horizontal position by 128 when the vertical offset is within range, and nudges the vertical position by 256 when the horizontal offset is within range. It then updates the status byte and derived fields.

name: nudge_entry_unconditional_steps
description: Nudges the horizontal position by 128 and, when the target is within range, the vertical position by 256, both toward the reference point. It then updates the status byte and derived fields.

name: offset_entry_and_nudge_vertical
description: Sets the horizontal position to its stored value plus 128 and nudges the vertical position by 256 when the target is far away. It then updates the status byte and derived fields.

name: nudge_entry_side_by_256
description: Moves the vertical position by 256 toward the side of the reference value when the horizontal offset is within range. It then sets the status fields and derived fields from the new position.

name: offset_entry_vertical_by_256
description: Sets the vertical position to its stored value plus 256, then updates the status byte and derived fields.

name: update_status_when_flag_set
description: When the flag argument is non-zero, sets the status fields chosen by a status byte. In all cases it then updates the derived fields from the position.

name: set_status_and_derive_fields
description: Calls a routine, sets the status fields and the mode field, then computes the derived fields from the position.

name: advance_entry_position_only
description: Adds velocity values to the position fields, updates the vertical position with an overflow check, and sets the derived fields from the new position.

name: update_entry_drag_zone
description: Applies drag to the velocity, advances the position and tests the new position through a routine. Depending on the result it sets an entry state code or calls a routine with fixed arguments in a particular zone, then updates the status byte and derived fields.

name: update_entry_position_and_zone
description: Advances the position by its velocity and tests the new position through a routine. Depending on the result it sets an entry state code or calls a routine with fixed arguments in a particular zone, then updates the status byte and derived fields.

name: update_speed_status_and_fields
description: Sets a status byte from whether the sum of the absolute velocity components exceeds 256, clears a derived field when a counter is at or above 2689, and sets the remaining derived fields from the position.

name: update_speed_status_from_argument
description: Sets a status byte from whether the absolute vertical velocity plus the argument exceeds 256, clears a derived field when a counter is at or above 2689, and sets the remaining derived fields from the position.

name: update_status_from_sum_arguments
description: Sets a status byte to one when the sum of its two arguments exceeds 256, clears a derived field when a counter is at or above 2689, and sets the remaining derived fields from the position.

name: clear_status_and_set_fields
description: Clears a status byte, clears a derived field when a counter is at or above 2689, and sets the remaining derived fields from the position.

name: derive_position_fields_only
description: Sets the derived fields from the position: a negated vertical field, the horizontal position, and a vertical value computed from the current position.

name: update_entry_with_velocity_damping
description: Applies drag to the velocity, advances the position and checks a routine result. On certain results it halves the velocity components, clamps a speed counter to 2624 and sets state fields chosen by a threshold of 25600, then updates the status byte and derived fields.

name: update_entry_with_offset_damping
description: Adds an offset to the position, checks a routine result and may halve the velocity components. It clamps a speed counter to 2624, sets state fields chosen by a threshold of 25600, then updates the status byte and derived fields.

name: clamp_speed_and_update_status
description: Clamps a speed counter to 2624, sets state fields chosen by a threshold of 25600 when the clamp applied, then updates the status byte and derived fields.

name: set_flag_and_update_status
description: Sets two flag bytes to one and six, sets the status byte when the sum of the absolute velocity components exceeds 320, then sets the derived fields.

name: update_status_from_argument_threshold
description: Sets the status byte when the absolute vertical velocity plus the argument exceeds 320, then sets the derived fields from the position.

name: update_status_from_sum_threshold
description: Sets the status byte when the sum of its two arguments exceeds 320, then sets the derived fields from the position.

name: clear_status_and_derive_fields
description: Clears the status byte and sets the derived fields from the position.

name: initialize_entry_position
description: Sets the first and third fields and the vertical value of a record from stored position values, and sets the remaining derived fields.

name: classify_entry_zone
description: Classifies an entry's position against one of two sets of fixed boundary values, chosen by a flag byte, and returns a zone code of one, two, four or eight. It calls a routine to check the first boundary before testing the vertical position.

name: zone_code_from_vertical_position
description: Returns a zone code from the vertical position: four when it is at or above 27777, eight when it is below 7424, and zero otherwise.

name: zone_code_below_lower_limit
description: Returns eight when the argument is below 7424, otherwise returns the incoming zone value unchanged.

name: classify_entry_zone_inline
description: Sets up fixed boundary values, calls a routine to test them against the entry, then returns a zone code of one, eight or four from the vertical position.

name: classify_vertical_zone_code
description: Returns four when the vertical position is at or above 27777 and eight when it is below 7424, leaving the zone value unchanged otherwise.

name: check_lower_vertical_limit
description: Returns eight when the argument is below 7424, otherwise returns the incoming zone value unchanged.

name: add_routine_value_return_change
description: Obtains a value from a routine, adds it to a stored value through a pointer, and returns the old value minus the new one.

name: add_offset_return_change
description: Obtains a value from a routine, adds the second field of a record to it, stores the sum through a pointer and returns the old value minus the new one.

name: clamp_position_to_bounds_mask
description: Clamps a position pair against minimum and maximum bounds held in a record, calling a routine to resolve each bound that is crossed. It returns a bit mask recording which of the four bounds were hit.

name: integrate_motion_with_decay
description: Copies the current position into two output values, then repeatedly decays the velocity by a sixteenth and adds it to the position. It counts steps while a limit or a flag allows and returns the step count.

name: manhattan_distance_2d
description: Returns the sum of the absolute horizontal and vertical differences between two points.

name: sum_abs_and_signed_difference
description: Returns the absolute difference between two register values added to the signed difference between two other register values.

name: add_difference_to_argument
description: Returns the difference between two register values added to the incoming argument.

name: chebyshev_distance_2d
description: Returns the larger of the absolute horizontal and vertical differences between two points.

name: compute_normalized_offset
description: Stores the horizontal and vertical differences between two points into two output values. When their absolute sum is non-zero it replaces them with values from routines, then calls a routine with both outputs.

name: normalize_offset_if_nonzero
description: When the absolute second value plus the first is non-zero, replaces the two output values with results from routines. It then calls a routine with both outputs.

name: refresh_offset_if_nonzero
description: When the sum of the two register values is non-zero, replaces the two output values with results from routines. It then calls a routine with both outputs.

name: find_region_hit_in_list
description: Walks a linked list of bounding boxes and returns the value attached to the first box that contains the stored position, with its first coordinate offset by 256. It returns zero when the list ends without a match.

name: find_region_for_entry
description: Walks a linked list of bounding boxes, testing the entry's position against each box's ranges, and returns the value attached to the first box that contains it. It returns zero when no box matches.

name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero without doing any work, so it is an empty stub.
